job: Read a report's findings on the page, then get the PDF and cite it.
purpose: A report's page as an fd-site-article cover: breadcrumb, a display title and standfirst with the key facts (fd-kv) at the head's end, the signature texture as a wide cover, numbered key findings (fd-site-features list in the text), the first two chapters with a chart and a table, each with its source, then a short gated form (name, work email, company) that gives the PDF, and Cite this. More research follows as covers.
useWhen: The findings should be readable, and citable, without the PDF.

avoidWhen.when: A paper with sections, footnotes and references read in full on the page.

sections.why: Shared with the product pages; Resources is the current section.
A report's front page: the head and key facts across the container over the texture, then the reading column with findings, chapters and the download.
More from the same shelf, each with its drawn cover.
After a report the reader looks for the next one.
